run_download_all_files: run the download_large_files script to download all file groups from the S3 bucket
run_download_odac_files: run the download_large_files script with the odac argument to download ODAC-related files
run_download_adsorbml_files: run the download_large_files script with the adsorbml argument to download AdsorbML challenge files
download_file_group: call download_file_group with a file group name to download that group of files from S3
change_path_for_pypi: call change_path_for_pypi to modify file paths for PyPi-installed fairchem builds
